description: Implementation of a DU connection manager handling DU connections, message forwarding, and cleanup routines in a 3GPP-related telecommunications system.

classes.name: du_connection_manager::shared_du_connection_context
classes.description: Holds context for a DU connection, including its index and message handler, shared between manager and notifier.

classes.name: du_connection_manager::f1_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
classes.description: Thread-safe notifier forwarding F1AP messages from DU to CU-CP, managing connection lifecycle.

methods.name: connect_du
methods.description: Associates a DU index with the connection context and retrieves its message handler.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the DU connection has been established.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Removes the DU connection and notifies closure.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Forwards an F1AP message from DU to the handler.

methods.name: f1_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
methods.description: Constructor that increments DU count; destructor that decrements DU count and defers context disconnection; handles message dispatching.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Dispatches received F1AP message to CU-CP executor.

methods.name: du_connection_manager
methods.description: Main class managing DU connections, message forwarding, and cleanup routines.

methods.name: handle_new_du_connection
methods.description: Handles new DU connection requests, creates DU processor, and manages connection context.

methods.name: handle_f1c_gw_connection_closed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a DU connection is closed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops all DU connections and waits for cleanup.
